sup:70140.text:
Hello,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are very excited about the opportunity to work together with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and to prove ourselves as a reliable partner for your business!

For our offer, we can propose a price of €47.00 per unit, alongside a quality commitment of 6400 ppm. 

Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days. We are eager to show you what we can do and hope this initial quote meets your expectations. Let us know if you have any questions at all.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

thank you for your offer regarding kalwisz: bearing brackets in red.

We value our cooperation.

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

move.text:
Hello,
many thanks, good to have your reply!
we can move a bit:
Our terms: a price of €48.00 per unit, a quality commitment of 300 ppm, a chargeback of €300.00 per complaint.
To be fully transparent with you:
We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We see your figures, but we cannot give up margin right now. Faster payment would help us more than anything.
My colleagues will reply about the cost breakdown. Let's agree on 47.50 EUR so we can keep the machines running.
Alternatively, with a quality commitment of 2500 ppm: €47.50 per unit.
Material accounts for about 30 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.
We really want this business - let's make it happen!
Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

Hello,

Thank you for your continued interest in working with Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.

Our current Angebot stands at a price of €47.00 per unit, a quality commitment of 300 ppm, and a chargeback of €300.00 per complaint. Please note that this offer stays valid for 7 days.

I've said it a few times now: if you want a better price, we need faster payment. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 60 days net. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. Let's agree on 47.00 EUR or talk about payment terms so we can wrap this up and build a strong partnership together.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
